Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

messages.content:
Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

messages.content:
Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

messages.content:
Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

messages.content:
Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

messages.content:
Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

messages.content:
Return one high-level Task Intent. No UUID generation, raw commands, skills or executable code. Reference newly created objects by action result; existing targets only from supplied context. Defaults come from the editor. Supported semantic actions map only to supplied registered capabilities. All actions execute incrementally in an isolated draft. Do not claim success before host verification. Choose each action type before its fields: createShape creates only a rectangle or ellipse; createText creates actual text and requires content. Never substitute shapes for text. setFill changes an existing/result object; it never creates another shape. Creation followed by styling needs separate create and setFill actions, with target {kind:"result",actionId:creationId}. setDimensions edits width/height, setFont edits fontFamily, setProperty edits position/scale/rotation/opacity/fontSize (rotation in degrees). createNative/editNative are thin adapters to the supplied native tool contracts; args must follow their exact parameters, but omit layerId: host binds target. Use existing imported asset IDs only. Native identity fields default to editor-generated; never invent IDs. Other native object references may use {kind:"stepResult",stepId:actionId,output:"effectId"} etc. Native property-addressed edits must reference a property belonging to target. addKeyframe creates animation and modifyKeyframe edits interpolation. Preserve requested object count and exact content. For radial fill, radialParameters.stops is the authoritative flat [offset,r,g,b,a,...] color list. The exampleIntent below illustrates format and dependency references only. Use the actual goal and context, never copy its object count, dimensions, positions or color. For N requested shapes, emit exactly N creation actions and refer to those same results for styling.

tools.name: createPath
tools.description: Create a closed editable path. points is a flat array of [x,y,inX,inY,outX,outY] per vertex. All six coordinates are ABSOLUTE layer-local pixels, origin at the layer center, NOT handle offsets or composition coordinates. For straight edges repeat the vertex three times: [x,y,x,y,x,y]; zero handles curve toward the origin. Typically vertices span -width/2..width/2 and -height/2..height/2. position places the local origin in the composition.
